chapter_mission: Ben arrives on Coruscant roughly half a day after Elya sent the message. The body is not warm-on-the-floor fresh, but the investigation is fresh: access controlled, first reports unfinished, official assumptions still forming. Inspector Cale Dorrin, a GA Justice / Coruscant Security investigator assigned to sensitive old-GAG and political-crime cases, controls the scene and lets Ben in under limits because Elya’s message makes him relevant and Luke has quietly vouched for the urgency. Ben senses Force-trauma and recovers the damaged Jacen-sealed duplicate manifest fragment hidden by Elya’s records instincts, not in an obvious safe.
chapter_turn: Dorrin’s first records check points toward an old GAG personnel/prosecution trail Ben cannot interpret alone.

Reader-facing clarity note: The fragment is not enough to solve the case. It shows a duplicated shipment identity, a quarantine/survey disguise, Jacen’s personal encryption marker, and a partial GAG logistics/audit trace. Dorrin can validate the official case context and preserve access, but he cannot interpret what the fragment means.
